summary: Generalized Gold payment (issue #303): one authoritative GoldQuote in L5R.Core (GoldCostRule data on AbilityDefinition, interpreted only in GoldQuotes.cs) replaces the four hand-kept cost chains (ValidateAbility, AbilityActions, per-ability Pay calls, client RenderTargeted). ActionOption carries Gold plus per-target TargetGold; GameCommand.GoldAmount carries a player-chosen variable amount. The client has one RenderGoldPanel for purchase, recruitReserve, equip, playStrategy and every costed useAbility, with retargeting and an amount control. Wire (WireGameCommand, AvailableAction, MatchSession.ToWire) updated; DeckPosition/TargetPlayerId were being dropped online and are now carried. Bugs the single function exposed and fixed: Kharmic never offered, non-Strategy Discipline offered disabled, Invest reactions offered with no sources, Noritada Invest and non-Strategy Discipline never charged, equip affordability ignored Katagi, QueryActions threw with The Earth's Hunger in hand during battle. Wiring Exchange of Letters, Urgency, Virtuous Charity, At Any Cost, A Stain Cleansed and Disgraceful Conduct, and Virtuous Charity's opponent-pays prompt, are deferred (see docs/decisions/2026-09-18-generalized-gold-payment.md).
validation: bash tools/check.sh (full, incl. client build, Godot import and headless smoke): 195 core, 57 published, 18 gold-parity, 20 gold-quote, 9 deck-format, 10 deck-workshop, 14 ai, 6 server, 5 client-transport, 43 python content tests -- all pass. GoldParityTests (18) pass unchanged on unmodified origin/main and on this branch. Native client (Godot 4.7.2 mono, Windows, NVIDIA GPU): bash tools/check-gold-payment.sh -- 8 scripted gold-* states drive the real controls (Kharmic fixed cost, Equip (Battle) retarget swapping quote and sources, variable amount raise/lower/confirm) plus payment, purchase and published-board-target-confirm regression runs; screenshots viewed. Scripted input on one Windows machine; not a human playtest, not macOS.
remaining: Six cards not wired by design; opponent-pays prompt needs a rules decision; PR #275 (scalar ActionOption.GoldCost for equip) overlaps MatchQueries.cs/Main.Actions.cs and must be reconciled by whichever lands second. Human rules acceptance open.
